title: pinus luchuensis subsp. taiwanensis
intro: Pinus luchuensis subsp. taiwanensis, commonly known as Taiwan red pine, is a subspecies of evergreen coniferous tree native to Taiwan. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits of reducing fever and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Taiwan red pine include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Taiwan red pine have been shown to exhibit potential therapeutic effects, including anti-cancer and neuroprotective properties.
